description: This file contains a SCSS (Sass) mixin library implementing Responsive Font Sizes (RFS). It provides functions, mixins, and configuration settings for generating responsive values for font sizes, paddings, margins, and other CSS properties based on screen size and resolution.

methods.name: divide
methods.description: Performs division with specified precision, handling units and avoiding division by zero.

methods.name: rfs-value
methods.description: Generates a CSS value string based on input, converting units as needed.

methods.name: rfs-fluid-value
methods.description: Calculates a fluid, responsive value for CSS properties based on screen size parameters.

methods.name: rfs
methods.description: Main mixin that applies responsive font sizes or other properties, managing media queries and responsive calculations.
